grade_rationale: Automatic F — confirmed red-team breach of critical objectives: state machine bypass (RED-002), unauthorized CI/CD cycle creation (RED-008), full pipeline takeover (RED-009). Per grading policy, any confirmed red-team breach of a critical objective results in automatic F.

findings.title: No Authentication on Any API Endpoint
findings.description: Every API endpoint is publicly accessible with zero credentials. No authentication middleware exists anywhere in the application. RED-001 confirmed live exploitation.
findings.remediation: Add JWT bearer token validation middleware (express-jwt) before all /api/* routes. Propagate req.user to all layers. Protect intake endpoints with HMAC shared-secret verification.

findings.title: State Machine Bypass, Unauthorized Cycle Injection & Full CI/CD Pipeline Takeover
findings.description: Three confirmed exploits: (a) force-approve bypasses 5-agent voting quorum in 3 requests; (b) POST /api/cycles with empty body injects unauthorized pipeline; (c) 12 unauthenticated requests complete full 5-stage CI/CD pipeline in ~30s.
findings.remediation: Require manager role for force-approve, cycle creation, and stage completion. Remove or protect the force-approve escape hatch. Add signed tokens for stage completion.

findings.title: Full Dataset Enumeration via Unbounded Pagination Limit
findings.description: GET /api/feature-requests?limit=999999999 returned all 60 items unauthenticated. No server-side cap on the limit parameter.
findings.remediation: const limit = Math.min(req.query.limit ? parseInt(..., 10) : 20, 100); — apply in workItems.ts and dashboard.ts.

findings.title: Vote Manipulation via Unauthenticated Retrigger
findings.description: POST /api/feature-requests/:id/retrigger clears all votes and re-runs AI evaluation with no auth. Attacker can game voting indefinitely.
findings.remediation: Require manager role for /retrigger. Add rate limiting (max 3 retriggers/item/24h). Log retrigger events in audit trail.

findings.title: Soft-Deleted Blocker Permanently Locks Dependent Items (DoS)
findings.description: Deleting a blocker orphans dependency links. Dependents are permanently locked in pending_dependencies with has_unresolved_blockers=true. No recovery path — exploitable DoS.
findings.remediation: On soft-delete, remove the item from all dependent blocker lists. Recalculate has_unresolved_blockers and re-evaluate pending_dependencies status.

findings.title: No Authorization / RBAC on Privileged Endpoints
findings.description: No role-based access control. Any authenticated user could approve, reject, or dispatch any item. OWASP-ASVS V4.1/V4.2, SOC2 CC6.3.
findings.remediation: Define roles: viewer | submitter | reviewer | manager. Implement authorization middleware. Apply least-privilege per endpoint.

findings.title: Intake Webhooks Accept Forged Requests — No HMAC Signature Verification
findings.owasp: A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.description: No HMAC signature verification on Zendesk and automated webhook endpoints. Any actor can inject arbitrary work items.
findings.remediation: Verify X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature via HMAC-SHA256 using crypto.timingSafeEqual(). Store secret in env var.

findings.title: Rejection Cascades to Auto-Dispatch Dependents (Business Logic Flaw)
findings.description: Rejected blockers trigger downstream dependent auto-dispatch. A rejected prerequisite should halt dependents, not release them.
findings.remediation: Audit cascade logic. Rejected blockers should move dependents to blocked/cancelled status.

findings.title: Missing Required Audit Events (login_attempt, permission_denied, data_export)
findings.description: 3 of 4 required audit events cannot be emitted. No auth system means login_attempt and permission_denied are impossible. data_export endpoint does not exist.
findings.remediation: Implement auditLog(event, actor, context) function. Emit all 4 required events with actor identity once SEC-001 is resolved.

findings.title: Prometheus /metrics Endpoint Publicly Accessible — Operational Intelligence Leak
findings.description: RED-006 confirmed: /metrics exposes route labels with entity IDs, request counts, and timing. No authentication.
findings.remediation: Restrict /metrics to localhost via reverse proxy, or add bearer token check from env var.

findings.title: Internal Error Messages Leaked to HTTP Clients
findings.description: RED-007 confirmed: error messages expose internal ID format schema, entity naming, and validation rules.
findings.remediation: Return generic 'Internal server error' for all 500 responses. Log full error context internally only.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.description: No rate-limiting middleware. Enables data flooding, brute-force, and memory exhaustion.
findings.remediation: npm install express-rate-limit. Apply 100 req/15min global, stricter on state-mutating and auth endpoints.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers (No helmet)
findings.description: No CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy. Express leaks X-Powered-By.
findings.remediation: npm install helmet. app.use(helmet()). app.disable('x-powered-by').

findings.title: No CORS Policy Configured
findings.description: No CORS middleware. Cross-origin authenticated requests will be possible once auth is added.
findings.remediation: app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN, credentials: true })).

findings.title: Intake Routes Skip Enum Validation on type and priority
findings.description: Intake routes accept arbitrary strings as type and priority via body.type || default pattern without enum validation.
findings.remediation: Apply enum validation from workItems.ts lines 29-42 to both intake routes.

findings.title: Race Condition in setDependencies (Non-Atomic Remove+Add)
findings.description: setDependencies performs non-atomic remove-then-add. Concurrent requests observe intermediate inconsistent state.
findings.remediation: Wrap dependency update logic in a synchronous atomic operation. Use DB transaction when persistent store is introduced.

findings.title: routing→approved Transition Enables Partial State Machine Bypass
findings.description: Direct routing→approved transition is permitted, allowing items to skip the assessment stage.
findings.remediation: Remove routing→approved edge from state machine. Add unit test asserting forbidden transitions are rejected.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest — In-Memory Store with No Persistence
findings.description: All data in JavaScript Map in process memory. No persistence, no encryption at rest, no DR. Data lost on restart.
findings.remediation: Introduce PostgreSQL or SQLite with encrypted storage. Inject credentials via env vars. Implement hardDelete(id).

findings.title: No TLS/HTTPS Enforcement
findings.description: Backend binds to plain HTTP. No HSTS. No startup check for production TLS.
findings.remediation: Enforce TLS at ingress for production. Add HSTS via helmet. Add startup warning if NODE_ENV=production and TRUST_PROXY unset.

findings.title: iframe Without sandbox Attribute
findings.description: Debug portal iframe has no sandbox attribute. Content runs with full permissions.
findings.remediation: Add sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms" to the iframe element.

findings.title: No Data Retention / Hard Delete Mechanism
findings.description: Soft-deleted items remain in store indefinitely. No hard-delete, no retention policy, no right-to-erasure.
findings.remediation: Implement hardDelete(id). Define 90-day retention policy. Scrub PII from intake payloads before storage.

findings.title: Actor Identity Missing from Audit Entries and changeHistory
findings.description: State transitions hardcode agent: 'manual-override'. changeHistory has no actor ID field. Not SOC2-compliant.
findings.remediation: Add actor parameter to buildChangeEntry(), sourced from req.user.id once SEC-001 is resolved.
